children: Sept 25 (Reuters) - Canadian wholesale trade most likely fell 1.5% in August from July, largely driven by lower sales in the agricultural supplies industry group within the miscellaneous subsector and the motor vehicle and motor vehicle parts and accessories subsector, Statistics Canada said in a flash estimate on Friday.   The estimate was calculated based on a weighted response rate of 68.6%. The average weighted response rate for the survey over the previous 12 months has been 83.7%.        NOTE: All figures are seasonally adjusted.     (Reporting by Dale Smith; Editing by Promit Mukherjee) ((promit.mukherjee@tr.com))
